title: HtmlCite
responsibility: Renders the native cite element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlCite.attributes
inputs.description: Native cite attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlCite.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native cite element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlCite
outputs.description: The actual native cite element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
